notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1957 volume. Curated: the 1955 bond program's first contracts (Larsen and McLaren pools, Balboa bleachers, Funston and Silver Terrace bleachers, Hayes Valley), Storyland, the Hall of Flowers architects, namings (Balboa diamonds, Kezar press box), the Upper Noe dedication.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (repairs, tennis resurfacing, zoo, golf, Camp Mather, Aquatic Park groin) not curated. The Martin Hanley Memorial Ring (horsemen's ring at Main Drive and Sixth Avenue, Res. 2632) has no page. The Funston diamond for Spike Hennessy was only referred to committee.
